dataset: Behavioral-Health Step-Down / Conservatorship Atlas — Verified Core (Top 15)
provenance_rule: Every numeric cell is either (a) a value traceable to a cited public source with a year, or (b) null with reason 'not_published'. No estimated, interpolated, or model-generated values. Where a whole metric is not collected in comparable form across states, the cell is null even when a plausible number could be guessed. UPDATE (this pass): per-100k bed column fully populated from the complete TAC 2023 table; two previously-carried values (NC, MA) corrected to the authoritative figures; NY and VA involuntary-volume figures added with precise scope labels.
structure_credit: Column design and top-tier ranking logic adapted from a Gemini-authored draft; ALL numeric values in that draft were discarded and rebuilt from primary/near-primary sources. Cells that could not be independently sourced are left null.

confidence_legend.confirmed: Value stated in a primary or near-primary source with a year.
confidence_legend.qualitative: Statutory/structural fact verified, but not a number.
confidence_legend.not_published: No comparable state-level figure located in a citable public source.

column_definitions.state_psych_beds_per_100k: STATE-OPERATED psychiatric hospital beds per 100k. Single consistent definition. Source: Treatment Advocacy Center, survey Apr-Aug 2023, published Jan 2024 (via Becker's ranking). NULL where the specific state value was not exposed in a citable source — NOT back-filled from all-payer counts.
column_definitions.involuntary_or_conservatorship: Verified statutory mechanism + any sourced volume figure. Volume is null unless a specific citable count was found.
column_definitions.state_hospital_pressure: Documented congestion / forensic dominance / waitlist, with the specific sourced fact.
column_definitions.placement_bottleneck: Court action or sourced wait figure. Null if only anecdotal.
column_definitions.step_down_registry: Whether a real-time bed registry / availability dashboard exists (sourced). Bed-count inventories deliberately NOT numericized — no federal repository tracks intermediate step-down beds comparably across states, so any per-state count would be fabricated.

removed_from_gemini_and_why.state_hospital_forensic_pct: REMOVED as a column. Gemini gave a clean whole-percent value for all 50 states; forensic-vs-civil occupancy is not collected in comparable form nationally (it requires per-state legislative-audit pulls). Any full column is fabricated.
removed_from_gemini_and_why.step_down_continuum_beds_counts: REMOVED as numbers. No federal repository tracks intermediate/step-down bed inventories across states; per-state counts (450, 1100, 6500...) are not sourceable. Replaced with a sourced yes/no on registry existence.
removed_from_gemini_and_why.per_100k_mixed_definitions: Gemini's bed column silently mixed state-hospital and all-facility figures (e.g., Alaska 80.2). Rebuilt as state-hospital-only, single definition, blanks where the specific value wasn't in a citable source.
removed_from_gemini_and_why.specific_volume_figures: Several Gemini volume figures (FL 161,576 FY24; VA 26,000 ECO/TDO; NY 45,000) were not verifiable in this pass and were replaced with the specific figures that ARE sourced, or nulled.
